The Socceroos' World Cup campaign continues on Friday when Australia faces Paraguay in San Francisco.

For fans who've managed to snare the day off, the midday (AEST) clash will be shown at public live sites across Australia, as well as live and free on SBS and SBS On Demand.

If watching at home isn't your thing, cities across Australia are turning public spaces and stadiums into giant viewing parties.

Don't miss our final match of the group stage, where the Socceroos take on Paraguay at the San Francisco Bay Area Stadium.

Since starting in 2024, Paraguay coach Gustavo Alfaro has transformed his side into a tough team to beat during qualification. Their World Cup qualification was celebrated with a national public holiday.
